meta.title: Fatimah AL Masaud | Business Systems Analyst
meta.description: Business Systems Analyst bridging business needs and technical implementation. Systems analysis, workflow design, and data migration.

hero.subtitle: Structured thinking and practical solutions that start with understanding the business, not the software.

about.heading: From requirement to system
about.paragraph1: Bachelor's degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), College of Business, Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University — graduated with Honors. Over two years of hands-on experience in systems analysis and solution development at an ICT company, working on diverse, complex projects.
about.paragraph2: My work is bridging the gap between business needs and technical implementation: understanding what stakeholders actually need, translating it into workflows and functional logic a development team can build, and documentation an end user can rely on.
about.degreeBadge: BSc Management Information Systems — Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University, With Honors

analysis.title: Precise analysis
analysis.body: Breaking complex operations into clear requirements that can be built and measured.

bridge.title: Point of connection
bridge.body: Where stakeholders and developers meet in one shared language, which cuts rework.

value.title: Visible change
value.body: Change is never handed over on its own — it comes with training and guidance until it is clear and usable.

membership.heading: Professional membership

membership.title: Management Information Systems Specialist

projects.heading: Selected projects
projects.body: Real work drawn from professional experience — system builds, process improvement, data migration, documentation and training.

erp.title: ERP modules built from scratch
erp.description: Contributed to building an in-house ERP system from the ground up, including HR, Requests, IT Support, and Asset Management modules — designing workflows and functional logic for each.

hrms.title: HRMS & ERP process enhancement
hrms.description: Analyzed and enhanced business processes across Jisr HRMS, Odoo, and the company's in-house ERP, translating operational needs into workflow design improvements.

migration.title: Data migration & integrity assurance
migration.description: Executed data migration from the Jisr platform to the internal system, including validation and backup across multiple servers to ensure data integrity and business continuity.

uat.title: UAT, documentation & training delivery
uat.description: Conducted User Acceptance Testing for the v1.0 to v2.0 system upgrade, prepared user manuals, and delivered training sessions to improve system adoption.

reporting.title: Reporting, dashboards & coding standards
reporting.description: Developed operational reports and dashboards, and collaborated with the Governance Department to standardize file coding and documentation practices.

cbahi.title: Automated website management system
cbahi.description: During a training program at the Saudi Central Board for Accreditation of Healthcare Institutions, simplified multi-department website updates by designing a centralized system managed by a single user, replacing scattered manual edits.

contact.heading: Let's talk
contact.body: Open to work that sits between business analysis and system building. For professional enquiries, email is the fastest way to reach me.
